offers.name: Dell 16 Plus 2-in-1 16" Touch Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 7 256V - 16GB LPDDR5X - 1TB SSD - Intel Arc - Windows 11 Home - Ice Blue

reviews.quote: Bright, striking mini-LED display... Clocking in at 467 nits in my testing, it's a great choice for outdoor or bright indoor workspaces.

praises: The 2.5K mini-LED panel CNET praised: bright (467 nits), responsive, great in tablet mode
Arc 140V handles light games and video editing better than any iGPU in this price class
Strong single-core speed for everyday productivity
complaints: Mini-LED costs battery: CNET's worst-in-class 8:58 was measured on this panel
Mushy keyboard and grainy non-haptic trackpad
Down-firing speakers 'as though audio was being broadcast from inside a cardboard box' (CNET)
BBY listing doesn't even state which display you're getting — panel-lottery risk
One TB4 port, no SD reader; soldered RAM

design_philosophy: The top-shelf BBY build of the DB06250: same Lunar Lake chassis as the value tiers but with the 2.5K mini-LED display that defines the line's one genuinely standout feature. It is closest to CNET's as-reviewed configuration, carrying both its strength (bright striking panel) and its penalty (battery drain).
rating_notes: Closest CA config to CNET's as-reviewed unit (258V/32GB/mini-LED); adjusted -0.3 gaming and -0.5 productivity for 256V/16GB per SHARED-dell-2in1.md anchor. Display tier inferred from price gap (IPS twin $1,531 vs this $1,952) — BBY name omits panel; noted as likely mini-LED.
standouts: Best display of the Dell 2-in-1 line
